authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-126 platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader-closure design contract: the allowlist taxonomy, the identity/version rule shape, the declared-vs-ambient split, retained loader-trace requirement, and the negative-test classes. It applies nothing, does not populate per-OS package tables, does not re-own DR-G07 extraction, does not re-decide D-006 numbers, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-126 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-126 a T2-02 candidate that locks the qualitative TCB shape D-006 left to this row, and reserves populated OS tables as G22 evidence.

registerRowQuoted.locationDiscipline: Located by the line beginning '| DR-126 |'.
registerRowQuoted.rowVerbatim: | DR-126 | Platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader closure | Security + release + platform owners | [Exact-byte delivery](04-lifecycle-delivery-and-operations.md#exact-byte-delivery) | Closed OS ABI/loader/libc/framework/cert/font/ICU-class allowlist and identity rules; retained loader traces; undeclared-system-resolution negative tests | OPEN | Hard blocker for platform qualification |

tcbTextCarriedVerbatim.surroundingLaw: The full Exact-byte delivery section is L141-166. This row owns the last paragraph (TCB). Extraction/symlink/TOCTOU/spawn-binding remain DR-G07 / DR-103.
linesVerbatim: The signed closure also declares the platform base/host-ABI TCB. A closed
allowlist and identity/version rule covers every permitted OS ABI, loader, libc,
framework, certificate store, font, ICU, and comparable system-class dependency.
Loader traces are retained at qualification. Undeclared library/framework/tool
resolution, alternate loader search, or identity drift refuses; hostile clean
machines prove no ambient system dependency can enter silently.

governingSources.role: INHERITED v1-era pin. Named properties only: D-006 qualitative TCB is this row; numbers are G02; D-002 slice platforms. Live digest is the remeasurement block whose standing is LIVE.

identityRuleShape.declared: Every permitted member appears in the signed closure TCB inventory as exactly the four-field signedEntry { platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence, originSearchPolicy }. That shape is exhaustive. A three-field form is not a conforming signed entry.

identityEvidence.form: See identityEvidenceUnion. Every signed entry carries exactly one tag from the classMap for its class.

identityRuleShape.sameMeans: Two runtime objects are the same member iff platformProfileKey, class, and identityEvidence compare equal under the class-specific rule. The optional sonameAbi companion inside identityEvidence is excluded from that comparison.
identityRuleShape.drift: Any runtime resolution whose authenticity identityEvidence (PLATFORM-ATTESTED or DIGEST-BOUND, excluding sonameAbi) is not an exact allowlist match. Companion presence/absence/mismatch is metadata only: retained, never allow/refuse.
identityRuleShape.populatedTables: Per-OS concrete members are RESERVED as G22 qualification evidence.

loaderTraces.rule: Loader traces are retained at qualification. Absence of a retained trace is a failed qualification.
observationBoundary: every actual resolution or system-class access attempt by the initial image, late loads, descendants, and helper tools, whether or not the object was declared in the signed TCB
descendants and helper tools the core spawns
non-loader system-class accesses (cert/font/ICU-class) covered by the taxonomy
retainedEventSchema: observedAt (monotonic non-negative integer; unique within the run; strictly increasing from runPreselectionRecord.observedAt through every later event in event order. Two events MUST NOT share observedAt. Non-increasing or duplicate refuses.)
signedCarrierDigest (UTF-8 hex sha-256 of the signed carrier; MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.signedCarrierDigest)
allowlistDigest (UTF-8 hex sha-256 of the signed allowlist table; distinct from signedCarrierDigest)
observedPlatformAttestation (required when identityEvidence tag is PLATFORM-ATTESTED; forbidden otherwise. Closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision}. extrasRejected.)
objectAuthenticityBindRecord (required on PLATFORM-ATTESTED events. Closed OS/scheme-discriminated tag from objectAuthenticityBind.tags. extrasRejected.)

materializedFileIdentity (required exactly when observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.interfaceId is rpm-checksig AND archiveAcquisition used cliInheritedFd, on both linux-file-backed and linux-pathless. Forbidden on preferredApi, apt-secure, and macos-codesign. Closed {dir, name, dev, ino, size, sha256, associationToken, selectionKey, archiveDigest, snapshotKind, seals}. extrasRejected. snapshotKind is exactly memfd-sealed. seals is exactly [F_SEAL_WRITE, F_SEAL_GROW, F_SEAL_SHRINK, F_SEAL_SEAL]. {dev,ino,size,sha256} MUST equal the sealed memfd identity after archiveSnapshot. associationToken MUST equal this event runIdentity plus observedAt. When the tag is linux-file-backed that same value MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken. selectionKey MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. archiveDigest MUST equal packagePayloadDigest and authenticityCore.payload.digest. This field is a top-level event member only; it MUST NOT appear inside objectAuthenticityBindRecord.)

descriptorConsumptionRecord (required exactly when interfaceId is rpm-checksig AND archiveAcquisition used preferredApi, on both linux-file-backed and linux-pathless. Forbidden on cliInheritedFd, apt-secure, and macos-codesign. Closed {dev, ino, size, sha256, selectionKey, archiveDigest, associationToken, stages, snapshotKind, seals}. extrasRejected. stages is exactly [snapshot, headerBind, digest, verify, extract]. snapshotKind and seals as materializedFileIdentity. {dev,ino,size,sha256} MUST equal the sealed memfd identity. Other equalities as materializedFileIdentity. This field is a top-level event member only; it MUST NOT appear inside objectAuthenticityBindRecord.)
observerProcessIdentity (qualification-run verifier process; not a frozen profile field)
mountNamespaceIdentity (Linux only; later events MUST equal the run-level preselection namespace or refuse)

companionObservation (required when a signed sonameAbi exists at companions.SONAME-ABI.encodingByTag for this event's authenticity tag: PLATFORM-ATTESTED envelope sibling or DIGEST-BOUND payload field; absent only when no companion exists at that one location)
loaderTraces.completenessProof: A trace is complete iff the trusted capture protocol reports sensor-health OK and lifecycle closure, and every actual attempt in the observation boundary is present as an event or an independently checkable inapplicability proof. Self-assertion by an incomplete recorder is not completeness. Partial traces fail. There is no harness-capability escape.

captureProtocol.sensor: A trusted capture source independent of the process under test. The recorder MUST NOT declare its own output complete.
captureProtocol.closureProbes: process-tree enumeration and lifecycle closure markers (start, last-descendant-exit, sensor-health) that can reveal an omitted event
captureProtocol.inapplicabilityProof: An explicit independently checkable proof object naming the class, the reason the class cannot occur on this profile, the probe that would have observed it if it could, and the signed carrier digest. A missing probe is not a proof.

evidenceJoin.table: Every observed event MUST match the signed active-profile table or fail. A false allowlistMatch with used outcome is a failed successor.
evidenceJoin.runBinding: Every later event binds runIdentity, subjectDigest, and signedCarrierDigest to the one runPreselectionRecord. later.signedCarrierDigest MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.signedCarrierDigest. later.observedAt MUST be a retained integer strictly greater than the immediately preceding event observedAt on this run, and unique within the run. later.observerProcessIdentity MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity under observerProcessIdentityShape. On Linux, setnsObservation.verifierBefore and verifierAfter MUST equal that same observerProcessIdentity under the closed {pid,starttime} serialization. There is no preselection eventKind. Any mismatch refuses.
evidenceJoin.INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: laterEventVariant volume/type equals runPreselectionRecord; Linux also linuxSelectedMountRecordIdentity. If identityEvidence is PLATFORM-ATTESTED, observedPlatformAttestation is required and binds to this event resolvedObjectIdentity.
evidenceJoin.PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED: laterEventVariant.observedPlatformAttestation is the closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision} record. authenticityCore.scheme/payload MUST equal the signed authenticityCore for this class. trustDecision MUST match the scheme variant and result MUST be success. pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal the closed subjectByScheme variant. Volume fields forbidden.
evidenceJoin.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: laterEventVariant.observedOrigin.actualOrigin is the sensor-emitted origin; lookupStepIndex equals event.route index; actualOrigin binds to resolvedObjectIdentity by same-event association (runIdentity + observedAt), not by projecting a path from object identity. Install-root volume fields forbidden.

companionObservationShape.whenRequired: A signed sonameAbi companion is present at the encodingByTag location: PLATFORM-ATTESTED envelope sibling, or DIGEST-BOUND libc payload field. Observation is then mandatory, not best-effort.
companionObservationShape.whenAbsent: No signed sonameAbi companion is present at that one location. companionObservation is omitted.

closedForms.absent: presence=absent. No soname or abiSelector fields.
closedForms.present: presence=present. soname and abiSelector are required and are the exact observed pair.
closedForms.mismatch: presence=mismatch. soname and abiSelector are required and are the exact observed pair used in the comparison.

companionObservationShape.signedLocation: One location per authenticity tag as companions.SONAME-ABI.encodingByTag. Not both. Not inside PLATFORM-ATTESTED authenticityCore.

observerProcessIdentityShape.linux: Verifier {pid, starttime} as overall field 22. Distinct from setnsObservation.helperProcessIdentity. Both are retained.
observerProcessIdentityShape.macos: {pid, kp_proc.p_starttime}. Before-and-after equality required around statfs.

mountNamespaceIdentityShape.linux: inode of the held ns/mnt descriptor. setnsObservation.receivedNsfdInode and helperPostSetnsNsInode MUST equal it.

laterEventVolumeFields.standing: RETIRED. No producer of any generation may emit this schema. EXTERNAL-ORIGIN is origin-only. Volume fields exist only on the INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME laterEventVariant.

loaderTraces.volumeEquality: Delegated to evidenceJoin per tag. INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME only. PATHLESS and EXTERNAL MUST NOT use install-root volume equality.

runPreselectionRecord.standing: Closed qualification-run record. Not an eventKind.
forbidden: volumeConstraint tag fields of later events
runPreselectionRecord.afterSelection: Later events bind runIdentity, subjectDigest, and signedCarrierDigest to this record. completePlatformProfileKey appears only on post-selection events.
runPreselectionRecord.supersedes: v13 eventKind preselection, v14/v15 preselectionRecord alias (deleted), and laterEventVolumeFields. Producers emit runPreselectionRecord only.

fields.val0: int32 first f_fsid component as canonical decimal: optional leading U+002D for negative, then 1-10 digits with no leading zeros except the number 0 itself
fields.val1: int32 second f_fsid component, same canonical decimal

macosVolumeIdentity.componentOrder: val0 then val1. No other order.
macosVolumeIdentity.oneSpelling: +0, 00, and 0 are not three spellings; only 0 is lawful for zero. No plus sign.
macosVolumeIdentity.equality: val0 numeric equal AND val1 numeric equal AND each field uses the canonical decimal spelling

fields.decodedMountPoint: UTF-8 bytes after kernel octal-escape decode; if the decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8, refuse
fields.major: non-negative integer parsed from mountinfo device major
fields.minor: non-negative integer parsed from mountinfo device minor

linuxVolumeIdentity.deviceParse: split mountinfo device on U+003A into exactly two decimal integers; any other form refuses
linuxVolumeIdentity.equality: decodedMountPoint UTF-8 bytes equal AND major numeric equal AND minor numeric equal

observedAttestation.producersEmit: Never as a complete event record. This object is only the nested authenticityCore serialization inside observedPlatformAttestation.
observedAttestation.retiredGenericDescriptions: The prior generic 40-hex SHA-1 / 64-hex SHA-256 field descriptions on this path are retired. The canonical payload encodings live on authenticityCore.
observedAttestation.equality: scheme tag equal AND payload fields byte-equal as defined on authenticityCore
observedAttestation.note: Legacy alias of authenticityCore only. Producers MUST emit observedPlatformAttestation as the complete PLATFORM-ATTESTED observation. A bare observedAttestation event field is not a lawful complete record.

fields.lookupStepIndex: MUST equal resolverObservation.lookupStepIndex and event.route index

observedOrigin.binding: actualOrigin bytes are the canonical path captured by resolverObservation for this same later event (runIdentity + observedAt). resolvedObjectIdentity is associated by that same-event token, not by projecting a path from the object identity.
observedOrigin.equality: actualOrigin UTF-8 bytes equal signed canonicalOrigin AND lookupStepIndex numeric equal

setnsObservation.when: Linux only. Required on runPreselectionRecord. Forbidden on macOS.
setnsObservation.helperProcessIdentity: {pid, starttime} of the dedicated helper; starttime is overall field 22
setnsObservation.receivedNsfdInode: decimal inode of the ns fd the helper received
setnsObservation.helperPostSetnsNsInode: inode of /proc/self/ns/mnt after setns; MUST equal receivedNsfdInode and heldNsInodeBefore/After
setnsObservation.mountinfoBytes: the exact /proc/self/mountinfo byte sequence read after successful setns. This is the retained evidence object.
setnsObservation.mountinfoDigest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of mountinfoBytes. MUST equal sha-256(mountinfoBytes).
setnsObservation.verifierBefore: {pid, starttime} of the verifier recorded immediately before helper start. MUST equal runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity under observerProcessIdentityShape.linux closed {pid, starttime} serialization.
setnsObservation.verifierAfter: {pid, starttime} of the verifier recorded immediately after helper exit. MUST equal verifierBefore AND runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity under that same serialization.
setnsObservation.heldNsInodeBefore: fstat of the held ns fd immediately before helper start
setnsObservation.heldNsInodeAfter: fstat of the held ns fd immediately after helper exit; MUST equal heldNsInodeBefore and receivedNsfdInode
setnsObservation.derivation: linuxSelectedMountRecordIdentity and filesystemTypeToken MUST be derived from mountinfoBytes by filesystemMeasurementTarget.linux.recordSelection and .token. A selection that cannot be replayed from mountinfoBytes refuses.
setnsObservation.ordering: verifierBefore and heldNsInodeBefore, then helper setns, then mountinfoBytes, then helper exit, then verifierAfter and heldNsInodeAfter.
setnsObservation.failClosed: Mismatch, missing field, extra field, helper death, or verifier/run-identity inequality refuses the profile.
setnsObservation.runJoin: verifierBefore = verifierAfter = runPreselectionRecord.observerProcessIdentity. Later events observerProcessIdentity MUST use that same value. Any mismatch refuses.

resolverObservation.when: EXTERNAL-ORIGIN later events. Required. Forbidden on PATHLESS.
resolverObservation.capturedPath: the exact path or object-handle-derived path emitted by the trusted resolver sensor for this same resolution operation that produced resolvedObjectIdentity. Association token is the same-resolution capture, not a projection from resolvedObjectIdentity.
resolverObservation.canonicalPath: filesystemMeasurementTarget.canonicalization of capturedPath (resolve every symlink; refuse if not exactly one path), then NFC then UTF-8
resolverObservation.lookupStepIndex: MUST equal event.route index in signed allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder
resolverObservation.binding: canonicalPath UTF-8 bytes MUST equal observedOrigin.actualOrigin AND signed canonicalOrigin. resolvedObjectIdentity is the authenticity identity of the object opened by this same later event (same runIdentity + observedAt). There is no path projection from object identity. Binding is same-event association, not identity-to-path derivation.
resolverObservation.failure: If capturedPath is absent, handle-to-path derivation fails, or canonicalization is not exactly one path, refuse.
resolverObservation.associationToken: The containing later-event identity (runIdentity + observedAt) is the association token. observedAt is unique and strictly increasing within the run, so the token is unique. capturedPath, canonicalPath, and resolvedObjectIdentity belong to that token only. Cross-event composition is forbidden.

observedAtRule.domain: Every runPreselectionRecord.observedAt and every later event observedAt on that runIdentity
observedAtRule.order: strictly increasing in event order. preselection is first. each later event MUST be greater than the immediately preceding event observedAt.
observedAtRule.associationToken: runIdentity + observedAt. Because observedAt is unique, the token is unique. capturedPath, canonicalPath, and resolvedObjectIdentity bind to this token only.
observedAtRule.refuse: missing, duplicate, non-integer, negative, or non-increasing observedAt refuses the run

observedPlatformAttestation.whenRequired: identityEvidence tag is PLATFORM-ATTESTED, pathless or file-backed
observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore: exactly PLATFORM-ATTESTED.authenticityCore {scheme, payload}. Not a second schema. Signed-to-observed identity equality uses this member only.

package-db.interfaceId: exactly one of rpm-checksig | apt-secure as selected by publisherToInterface
package-db.publisher: the profile publisher knownId that selected the interface

observedPlatformAttestation.sameSubjectBinding: Both members are produced from the same platformAttestationOperation execution against the same pathless subject or the same resolvedObjectIdentity. Mixing members from two executions refuses.

objectAuthenticityBind.standing: Closed OS/scheme-discriminated retained record. Required for every PLATFORM-ATTESTED observation. Package ownership metadata alone MUST NOT establish object authenticity.
objectAuthenticityBind.form: exactly one tag from the closed enum below. extrasRejected.

macos-codesign.when: osFamily macos and scheme codesign, pathless or file-backed

sameGuestBind.form: {associationToken, inputKind, checkValidityStatus, signingInfoStatus, cdhash}. extrasRejected. Not a native SecCodeRef.
sameGuestBind.cdhash: 40-hex lowercase from kSecCodeInfoUnique of that same guest
sameGuestBind.tie: these fields are the outputs of one macosCodesign.orderedStepsSameGuest execution for this event

linux-file-backed.when: osFamily linux and scheme package-db and volume tag INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME or EXTERNAL-ORIGIN

openedObjectObservation.canonicalPath: NFC-then-UTF-8 path of the same-event opened object
openedObjectObservation.openedBytesSha256: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the exact bytes read from the same opened handle
openedObjectObservation.associationToken: runIdentity + observedAt of this later event. This is the only associationToken placement on this tag. If a top-level materializedFileIdentity or descriptorConsumptionRecord is present, its associationToken MUST equal this same value. Those top-level fields are not tag members.

packageRelativePathRule.soleGrammar: archiveMemberPathGrammar is the only normative path grammar. Both INSTALL and EXTERNAL transforms MUST emit a string in that grammar before equality.
packageRelativePathRule.INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: strip the unique hostLocalCanonicalPath prefix, then apply archiveMemberPathGrammar. Remainder MUST equal matchedManifestMember.relativePath.
packageRelativePathRule.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: canonicalOrigin is a file path. Its directory is every component except the last. The opened object MUST equal canonicalOrigin or be under that directory; otherwise refuse. If equal, relativePath is the last component after archiveMemberPathGrammar. If under the directory, strip that directory prefix then apply archiveMemberPathGrammar. No fallback to the full path outside that directory.

linux-file-backed.matchedManifestMember: {relativePath, sha256}. extrasRejected. Subject to joinMust. Duplicate relativePath refuses. Duplicate sha256 is lawful.
linux-file-backed.packagePayloadDigest: 64-hex sha-256 of the exact archive bytes used for signature verification and extraction. MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest.
linux-file-backed.joinMust: matchedManifestMember.relativePath MUST equal the package-relative path produced by archiveMemberPathGrammar after the volume-tag transform. matchedManifestMember.sha256 MUST equal openedObjectObservation.openedBytesSha256. Those two fields MUST identify the same single authenticatedManifest member. Zero matches, more than one path match, or a hash-only match to a different member refuses. Hash uniqueness of the whole manifest is not required once path+hash selects the member.
linux-file-backed.rpmHeaderIdentity: present only when observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.interfaceId is rpm-checksig. Forbidden on apt-secure. Closed {sha256header, nevra, associationToken}. extrasRejected. sha256header MUST equal the normalized 64-hex output of headerIdentity.queryArgv for that same nevra. nevra MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. associationToken MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken. MUST NOT be used as, derived as, or substituted for packagePayloadDigest or authenticityCore.payload.digest.

linux-pathless.when: osFamily linux and scheme package-db and volume tag PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED

measuredBootBind.eventLog: TCG2 GetEventLog / EFI_TCG2_PROTOCOL.GetEventLog bytes for this boot. Retained exactly.

kernelEvent.digestSha256: 64-hex lowercase PE/COFF Authenticode image digest from the event. MUST equal the recomputed peCoffImageDigest of authenticatedKernelMember. MUST NOT be treated as a flat file sha-256.
kernelEvent.globalLogIndex: non-negative integer index of this event in full eventLog order
kernelEvent.pcr4SequenceIndex: non-negative integer index among PCR-4 events only

pcrSelection.pcrSelect: exactly PCR bits 0, 1, 2, 4, and 7 set; all other bits 0

quote.verifierChallenge: 32-byte CSPRNG value generated by the verifier at quote time. Not derived from runIdentity, observedAt, subject, or signedCarrierDigest.
quote.nonce: 32-byte sha-256 of pathlessCeremony.nonceBind over this event associationToken
quote.pcrDigest: 32-byte TPMS_ATTEST.attested.quote.pcrDigest. MUST equal SHA-256 of the reconstructed SHA-256 PCR values in ascending PCR index order: PCR0||PCR1||PCR2||PCR4||PCR7. There are no retained per-PCR quoted values.
quote.akTpmtPublic: TPMT_PUBLIC bytes of the AK. extrasRejected.
quote.tpmsAttest: the full TPMS_ATTEST bytes (same as quoted). magic MUST be TPM_GENERATED_VALUE. type MUST be TPM_ST_ATTEST_QUOTE. extraData MUST equal nonce.

measuredBootBind.akCertificateMember: the unique certificate-store DIGEST-BOUND four-field signedEntry {platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence, originSearchPolicy} that binds the AK certificate. A three-field form refuses. extrasRejected. Unknown AK refuses.
measuredBootBind.secureBootEvents: the PCR-7 EV_EFI_VARIABLE_DRIVER_CONFIG events for SecureBoot, PK, KEK, db, and dbx from the same eventLog. Retained exactly.
measuredBootBind.equality: kernelEvent.digestSha256 MUST equal authenticatedKernelMember.peCoffImageDigest. MUST NOT equal, be compared to, or be substituted for authenticatedKernelMember.sha256.

trustedHandoff.bootCurrent: UINT16 parsed from the authenticated EV_EFI_VARIABLE_BOOT VariableData for BootCurrent. Not taken from an unmeasured EFI runtime read unless that read equals this measured value.
trustedHandoff.bootOption: Boot#### load-option VariableData for that BootCurrent, from the matching authenticated EV_EFI_VARIABLE_BOOT event. extrasRejected.
trustedHandoff.filePathList: FilePathList from that authenticated Boot#### VariableData. This path is a security fact because it is inside the measured UEFI_VARIABLE_DATA preimage. It is not taken from UEFI_IMAGE_LOAD_EVENT.DevicePath.

callingFromBootOption.action: exactly the TCG PC Client string Calling EFI Application from Boot Option
callingFromBootOption.pcr4SequenceIndex: kernelEvent.pcr4SequenceIndex minus 1. Any other PCR-4 distance refuses.
callingFromBootOption.actionBytes: the exact 8-bit EV_EFI_ACTION Event bytes used as preimageBytes. Retained. SHA-256(actionBytes) MUST equal that event digest.

trustedHandoff.noInterveningPcr4Application: no EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION other than kernelEvent may appear after callingFromBootOption in PCR-4 sequence order before the first PCR-4 EV_SEPARATOR

preKernelReferences.form: closed list of {pcrIndex, globalLogIndex, eventType, recomputedDigest, signedEntry}. extrasRejected on each member.
preKernelReferences.join: recomputedDigest MUST equal event.digests[TPM_ALG_SHA256] and the transcript row digestSha256. signedEntry MUST be a four-field signedEntry whose identityEvidence tag is DIGEST-BOUND. recomputedDigest MUST equal identityEvidence.digest. Do not call eventPreimage(event). Pairing an event digest with an unrelated allowlisted entry refuses. Byte recomputation from preimageBytes is required only for kernelEvent and for ACTION/VARIABLE rows. For other code-bearing rows, signed digest equality is the intended proof and byte recomputation is not required; the preKernelReferences row and signedEntry join remain required.
preKernelReferences.requiredFor: every code-bearing transcript row on PCR 0/1/2/4/7 in the governing per-PCR separator interval, except the kernelEvent row. That includes code-bearing events after kernelEvent and before that PCR's separator. Appearance is mandatory. Byte recomputation is not.
preKernelReferences.classForCodeRows: The four-field signedEntry.class for a non-kernel codeBearing preKernelReferences row MUST be comparable system-class dependency. class loader is not used (classMap has no DIGEST-BOUND loader route). framework MUST NOT be used for firmware, CRTM, POST, IPL, or PE driver/application rows.

runtimeContinuity.roleGoverns: runtimeContinuity.role is the governing sentence for this field, in the same form as authenticatedManifest.uniqueness and peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.specificationGoverns.
runtimeContinuity.role: OPTIONAL HARDENING only. Not an interval proof. Not NT-TCB-KEXEC. Not sufficient to claim a running-kernel subject. Absent indicators MUST NOT refuse. Only a contradictory present value may fail closed: if /proc/sys/kernel/kexec_loaded exists and equals 1, refuse. All other absent/unreadable indicators are skipped.
runtimeContinuity.lockdown: if /sys/kernel/security/lockdown exists and is readable, a selected token other than integrity MAY be ignored (hardening). Absence MUST NOT refuse.
runtimeContinuity.kexecLoadDisabled: if the file exists, the value is retained as hardening. Absence or 0 MUST NOT refuse.
runtimeContinuity.kexecLoaded: if the file exists and equals 1, refuse. Absence MUST NOT refuse.
runtimeContinuity.bootCurrentNow: if EFI BootCurrent is readable and differs from trustedHandoff.bootCurrent, the difference is retained as hardening and MUST NOT refuse.

measuredBootBind.measuredBootTranscriptMatch: required. Governing interval: every PCR-0/1/2/4/7 event from the start through the first EV_SEPARATOR on that same PCR inclusive MUST equal signed measuredBootTranscript in order: same count, same pcrIndex, same pcrSequenceIndex, same eventType, same digestSha256. Extra, missing, type-mismatch, or digest-mismatch refuses. This sentence governs over any narrower PCR-0/1/2/4-only remnant.
measuredBootBind.transcriptDigest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of measuredBootTranscriptCanonical. MUST equal the signed PATHLESS measuredBootTranscriptDigest for this platformProfileKey and OS-ABI signed entry. Unknown, extra, or cross-entry transcript refuses.

buildIdDriftDetector.role: If both authenticatedKernelMember.gnuBuildId and /sys/kernel/notes NT_GNU_BUILD_ID are present and differ, retain the mismatch as a drift observation. MUST NOT refuse. MUST NOT pass NT-TCB-1 or NT-TCB-3. Absence MUST NOT refuse. A matching build-id MUST NOT be treated as proof that the executing bytes equal the firmware-launched member.

fromBootLockdown.derivation: kexecAbsenceDerivation over the architecture-selected decompressed payload is the structural proof.
fromBootLockdown.signedCarriage: Linux PATHLESS signedObject.kexecCapability MUST equal kexec-absent. signedObject.ikconfigDigest MUST equal the derived ikconfigDigest. Cross-entry substitution refuses.
fromBootLockdown.presentState: CORROBORATION only. /proc/sys/kernel/kexec_load_disabled MUST be absent. Presence refuses. If /proc/sys/kernel/kexec_loaded exists it MUST be 0. 1 refuses. Present-state absence is not the structural proof.
fromBootLockdown.loadOptionParse: Parse trustedHandoff.bootOption VariableData as EFI_LOAD_OPTION solely to extract FilePathList: UINT32 Attributes (little-endian); UINT16 FilePathListLength (little-endian); CHAR16 Description including one terminating U+0000; then FilePathListLength bytes of UEFI device path. Any overrun, truncated Description, or FilePathListLength past the end refuses. OptionalData remainder is retained as opaque bytes and MUST NOT be used as a security fact.
fromBootLockdown.optionalData: opaque; not a security fact. No token policy.
fromBootLockdown.role: kexec-absent is a fact about authenticated member bytes plus a signed inventory attestation. Present-state procfs only corroborates. Linux stays in slice 1; derivation failure or a kexec-capable IKCONFIG fails the machine, not the class.

kexecAbsenceDerivation.input: the exact authenticatedManifest member bytes selected by authenticatedKernelMember.relativePath (same bytes as sha256 and peCoffImageDigest)
kexecAbsenceDerivation.neverSearchRawWrapper: MUST NOT search the raw PE/COFF wrapper, overlay, certificate table, or any region outside the selected payload for IKCFG markers. A pair found only in those regions is not this derivation and MUST NOT be used.

checks: u8 at 0x1F1 is setup_sects; if 0 treat as 4
linux/x86_64.payload: pm_code_off = (setup_sects + 1) * 512. payload_offset = u32le at 0x248. payload_length = u32le at 0x24C. payload starts at pm_code_off + payload_offset and has length payload_length. The range MUST lie wholly inside the member. Overlap with setup, wrap, or zero length refuses.

linux/arm64.format: Linux EFI zboot or uncompressed arm64 Image
linux/arm64.zboot: Locate the unique LINUX_EFI_ZBOOT_HEADER whose id[4] is 7a 69 6d 67 ("zimg"). Zero or more than one refuses. payload_offset and payload_size are u32le at header+4 and header+8. compressed_type is the 32-byte NUL-padded ASCII field at header+20; accepted values gzip, xz, lz4, zstd, none. payload range MUST lie wholly inside the member.
linux/arm64.uncompressedImage: If no zimg header exists, the selected payload is the PE image section that contains the arm64 Image text (unique executable section). Treat compression as none. Ambiguous or zero executable sections refuse.

decompress.detect: gzip 1f8b, xz fd377a585a00, zstd 28b52ffd, lz4 02214c18, or none (already decompressed). Other magics refuse as unsupported-compression.
decompress.limit: decompressed output MUST NOT exceed 128 MiB. Truncation or decoder error refuses.
decompress.output: exactly one decompressed payload byte string P

kexecAbsenceDerivation.ikconfigPair: In P only, find every IKCFG_ST / IKCFG_ED ASCII marker pair. MUST be exactly one pair, IKCFG_ST before IKCFG_ED, the interval wholly inside P, no nested or overlapping pair. Zero, more than one, reversed, or out-of-P pairs refuse.
kexecAbsenceDerivation.extract: Bytes strictly between the unique markers MUST be a gzip stream. gunzip to UTF-8 .config text C. Bad gzip refuses. ikconfigDigest is SHA-256 of C.

kconfigSerialization.complete: C MUST contain CONFIG_IKCONFIG=y. Each assignment line is CONFIG_NAME=value or "# CONFIG_NAME is not set". CONFIG_NAME MUST be unique. A second assignment to the same name refuses. Other lines are comments or blank.
kconfigSerialization.disabledForm: Each requiredN symbol MUST appear explicitly as CONFIG_NAME=n or as "# CONFIG_NAME is not set". Omission is not disabled. =y or =m refuses.

kexecAbsenceDerivation.signedAttestation: signedObject.kexecCapability MUST equal kexec-absent and signedObject.ikconfigDigest MUST equal the derived ikconfigDigest. Signed carriage attests this validated result; it MUST NOT replace derivation.
kexecAbsenceDerivation.notThis: a raw-PE marker search, a missing-symbol-means-n rule, a constant token, or procfs as structural proof.

linux-pathless.authenticatedKernelMember: {relativePath, sha256, peCoffImageDigest, kexecCapability, gnuBuildId?}. extrasRejected. relativePath MUST select exactly one regular-file authenticatedManifest member. Zero or more than one path match refuses. sha256 MUST equal that same member's sha256. peCoffImageDigest MUST be recomputed from those same exact member bytes by peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm and MUST equal both the retained peCoffImageDigest field and kernelEvent.digestSha256. kexecCapability MUST equal kexecAbsenceDerivation output for those same exact member bytes and MUST equal the signed PATHLESS kexecCapability. The token is exactly kexec-absent when derivation succeeds. gnuBuildId is optional metadata and MUST NOT be authenticity. A non-PE/COFF member refuses.
linux-pathless.packagePayloadDigest: 64-hex sha-256 of the exact archive bytes used for signature verification and extraction. MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest.
linux-pathless.measuredBootProcedureRef: identityEvidenceUnion.tags.PLATFORM-ATTESTED.platformAttestationOperation.linuxPackageDb.pathlessCeremony is the only normative procedure. IMA file measurement and NT_GNU_BUILD_ID are not this bind.

authenticatedManifest.form: closed list of {relativePath, sha256}. extrasRejected on each member.
authenticatedManifest.builtFrom: the same archive bytes whose digest is packagePayloadDigest, after signature/index verification of those exact bytes
authenticatedManifest.uniqueness: relativePath MUST be unique after archiveMemberPathGrammar. Duplicate sha256 is lawful. joinMust selects on path and hash together. This supersedes any earlier sha256-uniqueness refusal.

archiveMemberPathGrammar.longestPrefixStrip: strip at most one leading './' only. Do not strip a lawful leading '.' that is part of a filename. Do not strip multiple prefixes.
archiveMemberPathGrammar.unicode: NFC then UTF-8 after prefix strip
archiveMemberPathGrammar.rpmCpio: apply longestPrefixStrip to the cpio member name, then reject
archiveMemberPathGrammar.debDataTar: apply longestPrefixStrip to the data.tar member name, then reject. APT authenticatedManifest MUST be built with this rule only.
archiveMemberPathGrammar.componentWise: split on U+002F and reject any component that is empty, ".", or ".."
archiveMemberPathGrammar.links: symlink/hardlink members are not digest members. A digest member MUST be a regular file.
archiveMemberPathGrammar.soleInput: authenticatedManifest.relativePath and packageRelativePathRule both MUST use this grammar only.

signedBinding.location: signed carrier field verifiedInstallRoot. Not a platformProfile selector member. Not part of completePlatformProfileKey. Not an inventoryFieldAuthor inventory entry.
signedBinding.coexistence: inventoryFieldAuthor remains the single author of inventory bytes. verifiedInstallRoot is a preselection carrier input, not inventory.
signedBinding.scope: Exactly one signed preselection binding point. Not derived from later object resolutions.
signedBinding.valueType: the exact-byte-delivery verified install-root path identity

serialization.treeRootToken: The signed tree root is the single character "/".
serialization.otherTokens: Every other value is a relative UTF-8 path after NFC. It MUST NOT begin with "/", MUST NOT be empty, and MUST NOT contain empty, ".", or ".." components. POSIX / separators. No trailing slash.
serialization.join: The host joins the verified host-local exact-byte install anchor A with the signed token T: if T is "/", the join is A; otherwise the join is A + "/" + T. Canonicalization runs on the join result.

equality.signedTokenBytes: NFC-then-UTF-8 bytes of the carrier field T after grammar validation. This comparison does not use the host-local join.
equality.hostLocalCanonicalPath: Canonicalization of join(A, T) on this host. Filesystem-volume join uses this path only.
equality.notOneComparison: T-byte inequality is a carrier defect. Host-path mismatch is a volume/preselection defect. They are not the same comparison.

serialization.normalization: NFC Unicode, then UTF-8. Normalization and encoding run before grammar validation and before signing.

signedBinding.anchor: the signed full-tree closure root as delivered under exact-byte delivery (file 04 Exact-byte delivery). Rides DR-G07.
signedBinding.absentDependency: If the exact-byte verified-root identity is absent, the profile refuses. This artifact does not invent that identity.

canonicalization.rule: Canonicalize the joined verifiedInstallRoot once, here, before any measurement. Resolve every symbolic-link component. The canonical path is the only path input to macOS statfs and to the Linux mount-point prefix match.
canonicalization.failure: A path that cannot be canonicalized to exactly one path refuses.

targetPath.is: the canonical path produced by canonicalization of signedBinding.verifiedInstallRoot
targetPath.not: ordinary host path resolution, a second live re-read of the install root, or a later object path

filesystemMeasurementTarget.rule: This target is observed BEFORE profile selection and binds the install-root volume. It does not require every later resolution to occupy that volume. INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME later resolutions MUST occupy that volume (sameVolume / volumeEquality). PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED later resolutions MUST NOT be failed for leaving that volume. EXTERNAL-ORIGIN later resolutions join their signed origin, not the install-root volume. A complete profile cannot be selected until this target is observed or the profile refuses.

sameVolume.decision: exact target volume, not merely the filesystem-type token
sameVolume.macosIdentity: same statfs.f_fsid as the preselection observation of targetPath
sameVolume.linuxIdentity: same (decoded mount-point, device) pair as the mountinfo record selected at preselection
sameVolume.retained: Applies only when the signed entry volumeConstraint is INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME. Preselection records the volume identity and the filesystem-type token. That tag's later event compares both: type token must match the selected profile member AND volume identity must equal the preselection identity. PATHLESS and EXTERNAL-ORIGIN MUST NOT be sent through this install-root equality. If an INSTALL-ROOT comparison cannot be made, refuse.

macos.interface: struct statfs.f_fstypename of the volume that contains the canonical targetPath. The path argument is that canonical path. No other interface.
macos.volumeIdentity: struct statfs.f_fsid of that same call
macos.failure: If the token or f_fsid cannot be observed the profile refuses.
macos.observerProcess: observerProcessIdentity is the closed pair {pid, process start time from sysctl kern.proc.pid / kp_proc.p_starttime}. Verify the pair immediately before and after the statfs call; mismatch refuses.
macos.namespace: mountNamespaceIdentity is absent on macOS. There is no inapplicable token and no Linux inode form.

linux.observerProcess: The verifier process that performs preselection observation. observerProcessIdentity is {pid, starttime} where starttime is overall field 22 (twentieth token after comm's final ')', post-delimiter index 19). Open /proc/<pid>/stat and /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt; record {pid,starttime} and fstat the ns fd. The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses. Re-read {pid,starttime} and fstat the held ns fd after the helper returns. Any pair or inode change refuses.
linux.namespace: Linux mount-namespace identity is the inode of the held /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt descriptor. The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses. Later resolvers MUST present the same inode AND the same selected-record identity or refuse.
linux.source: The only lawful Linux mountinfo reader is a dedicated helper that (1) receives the held ns fd, (2) enters that namespace with setns(nsfd, CLONE_NEWNS), (3) reads /proc/self/mountinfo, (4) exits. /proc/<verifierPid>/mountinfo opened from the observer's namespace is not the interface. Retain helper {pid,starttime}, the nsfd inode, and evidence that the bytes were read after successful setns. setns failure, helper death, or nsfd stale refuses.
linux.mountPointDecoding: decode kernel octal escapes (space, tab, newline, backslash) in the mount-point field before any comparison
linux.recordSelection: over decoded mount points, the record whose mount-point is the longest component-ancestor prefix of the canonical targetPath; if several records share that mount point, the last such record in file order. String prefix on undecoded bytes is not the comparison.
linux.retargeting: If between preselection and a later resolution the selected record's (decoded mount-point, device) pair changes, refuse.
linux.token: the first field after the '-' separator in that selected record (fs_vfstype). Not a numeric field ordinal. Linux struct statfs.f_type is not the token.
linux.failure: If verifiedInstallRoot is absent or non-unique, or canonicalization fails, or the token or volume identity cannot be observed, or selection is missing or ambiguous, the profile refuses.

order: Observe filesystemMeasurementTarget and refuse if unobservable/ambiguous.
Select the active complete (not stem-only) qualified platformProfile whose filesystem member matches that target.

Read the signed entry class. If the class is a pathlessClasses member, the volumeConstraint tag MUST be PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED; INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME or EXTERNAL-ORIGIN on that class refuses. Read the signed entry's volumeConstraint. If INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME: observe the actual object path, canonicalize it by the same symlink-resolving rule, select the object's volume by the same algorithm; the object's volume identity MUST equal the preselection volume identity AND the object's filesystem-type token MUST match the already-selected profile filesystem member; otherwise refuse. If PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED: do not require an object path or install-root volume equality; join the named pathlessObservation and the closed per-scheme subjectByScheme binding. If EXTERNAL-ORIGIN: join canonicalOrigin / allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder via resolverObservation same-resolution association; do not require install-root volume equality.
Allow only an exact allowlist match under identityEvidenceUnion AND originSearchPolicy.
Every other source or route is ambient/alternate and MUST refuse.

resolutionPredicate.declaredVersusAmbient: Declared = complete-profile allowlist entry + originSearchPolicy. Ambient = any other object or route.
