authenticityCore.form: {scheme, payload}. extrasRejected. This is the only authenticity serialization.

codesign.cdhash: 40-hex lowercase SHA-1 of the codesign cdhash the platform returned

package-db.name: NFC UTF-8
package-db.digest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the package bytes

authenticityCore.excludes: sonameAbi is never a member of authenticityCore and never participates in signed-to-observed authenticity equality.
authenticityCore.trustDecisionRequired: Observed authenticityCore is incomplete without a retained successful trustDecision from platformAttestationOperation. A cdhash or {name,version,digest} returned without result=success is not success. Invalid, untrusted, unavailable, ambiguous, or mismatched refuses.

packageBytes.collection: the unique byte sequence the package-db verification operation attests as that package's canonical payload under the database's published membership/root rule for {name, version}. If that rule does not yield exactly one byte sequence, refuse.
packageBytes.digestInput: exactly those payload bytes. No other files, signatures, or metadata unless the published membership/root rule includes them.

signedForm.form: exactly {authenticityCore, optional sonameAbi}. extrasRejected on the envelope.
signedForm.sonameAbi: optional signed-only sibling metadata on libc entries; forbidden on non-libc; never inside authenticityCore.payload; never part of authenticity equality

observedForm.loaderTracesAlias: loaderTraces.identitySerializations.observedAttestation is this same object, not a second definition.

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.sameSerialization: signed authenticityCore MUST equal observed authenticityCore field-for-field under the encodings above. sonameAbi is excluded from that equality. companionObservation is the only observed companion record. There is no second observed path.

codesign.observation: platformAttestationOperation.macosCodesign against the running kernel / OS ABI code object, same guest for validity and kSecCodeInfoUnique.
codesign.successResult: orderedStepsSameGuest all succeed and produce exactly one cdhash. A returned cdhash without trustDecision.result=success refuses.
codesign.canonicalSerialization: JSON object with keys in order kind, cdhash; cdhash is 40 lowercase hex; extras rejected.
codesign.binding: pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal this object. observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.scheme MUST be codesign. observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.payload.cdhash MUST equal subject.cdhash. signed pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal the observed subject. Mismatch refuses.

package-db.name: NFC UTF-8
package-db.digest: 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the firmware-launched kernel package bytes (archiveSnapshot digest)
package-db.observation: Linux pathless uses measuredBootBind (signed measuredBootTranscriptDigest + governing recomputeDigest + boot-manager handoff + PE/COFF equality) for firmware-launched-kernel-package. It does not observe or authenticate the currently executing image after a post-boot replacement. IMA, executingKernelBuildId-as-authenticity, and NT_GNU_BUILD_ID-as-pass/fail are not this observation.
package-db.successResult: mapped interface reports success and produces exactly one {name, version, digest} whose digest equals the named packageBytes digest. Unmapped publisher refuses.
package-db.canonicalSerialization: JSON object with keys in order kind, name, version, digest; kind is the exact token firmware-launched-kernel-package; extras rejected.
package-db.binding: pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal this object. kind MUST be firmware-launched-kernel-package. observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.scheme MUST be package-db. measuredBootBind.kernelEvent.digestSha256 MUST equal authenticatedKernelMember.peCoffImageDigest. authenticityCore.payload.digest is the sealed archiveSnapshot digest and MUST equal packagePayloadDigest. signed pathlessObservation.subject MUST equal the observed subject. Mismatch or unavailable TPM/log/transcript/handoff/PE-image refuses this machine, not the Linux slice-1 class.

optionalLibcCompanion.location: signed-only sibling on the libc envelope, outside authenticityCore. Never inside payload.
optionalLibcCompanion.comparison: sonameAbi is metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse and is not authenticity drift. Retained as companionObservation. Observed companion is never nested under taggedEvidenceForm or authenticityCore.

platformAttestationOperation.standing: Closed. Required for every PLATFORM-ATTESTED observation, pathless and file-backed.

macosCodesign.guest: SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes on the input code object. Pathless input is the running kernel / OS ABI code object. File-backed input is the resolved object of this later event.
orderedStepsSameGuest: SecCodeCheckValidity(guest, kSecCSDefaultFlags, NULL) MUST return errSecSuccess (0)
cdhash is the 20-byte CFData at kSecCodeInfoUnique in that info dictionary, encoded as 40-hex lowercase. If kSecCodeInfoUnique is absent or not exactly 20 bytes, refuse.
macosCodesign.sameGuestRule: Steps 2-4 MUST use the guest from step 1. A validity result and a cdhash from different guests refuse.
macosCodesign.trustDecision: {scheme: codesign, interfaceId: SecCodeCheckValidity, signingInfoInterfaceId: SecCodeCopySigningInformation, status: 0, result: success}
macosCodesign.identifierBinding: observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore.payload.cdhash MUST equal that kSecCodeInfoUnique encoding from the same guest.
macosCodesign.fileBackedInput: the same-event resolved object, obtained as the SecCode guest in step 1. Not a separately opened path.
macosCodesign.pathlessInput: the running kernel / OS ABI code object as the SecCode guest in step 1. Not a kernelcache pathname substitute.
macosCodesign.sameGuestBindRecord: objectAuthenticityBind.tags.macos-codesign.sameGuestBind is the only retained same-guest evidence. Do not retain a SecCodeRef.

publisherToInterface.note: alpine and arch remain lawful profile-selector knownIds. They have no PLATFORM-ATTESTED package-db interface in this contract. A PLATFORM-ATTESTED Linux entry whose publisher is alpine, arch, or OTHER-PUBLISHER refuses until a later successor names that interface.

linuxPackageDb.runningKernelImagePath: RETIRED as an authenticity bind. Use measuredBootBind. Filename/osrelease and executingKernelBuildId MUST NOT establish authenticity.

rpm-checksig.success: exit 0 and stdout is exactly one NEVRA line after trimming a single trailing newline. Any other exit, zero lines, or more than one NEVRA refuses.

apt-secure.success: exit 0 and exactly one package name before the colon. Ambiguous or none refuses.

owningPackageLookup.pathlessPath: Not an authenticity input. Package NEVRA for pathless Linux is the signed OS ABI allowlist member, not a /boot ownership query.
owningPackageLookup.fileBackedPath: Not an authenticity input. If used at all, it only nominates a package NEVRA/name to acquire. Authenticity is objectAuthenticityBindRecord only.

rpm-checksig.versionedInterface: rpm(8) --checksig as shipped by the publisher userspace. This contract does not pin an rpm major; a missing rpm binary refuses.
rpm-checksig.packageBytes: the sealed archiveSnapshot bytes taken from publisherArchivePath before headerBind. authenticityCore.payload.digest is sha-256 of those exact snapshot bytes. rpmdb does not contain those bytes and MUST NOT be treated as the archive. A held pathname descriptor is not the snapshot.
rpm-checksig.nameVersion: authenticityCore.payload.name and .version are the NEVRA name and EVR parsed from the publisher archive header. digest is sha-256 of those archive bytes.

archiveAcquisition.selectionKey: the unique NEVRA in rpmdb. Zero or more than one refuses. That NEVRA MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.name plus EVR.
archiveAcquisition.publisherArchivePath: qualification-run input. NFC UTF-8 absolute path of an already-present regular file that is the publisher .rpm for selectionKey. This contract does not download, reconstruct from rpmdb, or invent archive bytes. Absence, non-regular-file, or open failure refuses this machine.

preferredApi.name: librpm
preferredApi.open: fdopen the O_RDONLY roFd. rpmReadPackageFile is applied to that sealed snapshot, never to publisherArchivePath, never to an rpmdb iterator, and never to an undefined blob. Do not close or replace roFd after the snapshot transition.
preferredApi.headerBind: read lead, signature header, and immutable header from roFd. Parse NEVRA from that header. That NEVRA MUST equal selectionKey MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.name plus EVR. Compute SHA256HEADER over the immutable header region using the same preimage rpm uses for %{SHA256HEADER}. That value MUST equal headerIdentity.queryArgv for selectionKey.
preferredApi.hold: keep roFd open across headerBind, digest, verify, and extract. lseek to 0 between stages. Do not close and reopen roFd. The only permitted close/reopen is the snapshot O_RDONLY transition already completed.
preferredApi.digest: sha-256 of pread of the entire sealed roFd from offset 0 to EOF. MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest and archiveSnapshot.identity.sha256. Use of snapFd after close refuses.

verify.on: rpmts created for this run; header and fd from rpmReadPackageFile on roFd after lseek 0
verify.success: return value RPMRC_OK (0) and no failed signature class. Any other return, missing signature, or untrusted key refuses.

extract.on: roFd after verify and lseek 0. snapFd is closed and MUST NOT be named here.
extract.bytes: walk every member until rpmfiNext returns the end iterator. Any rpmfiArchiveRead short read or error refuses. for each regular-file member, hash the exact payload bytes returned by rpmfiArchiveRead. relativePath via archiveMemberPathGrammar.rpmCpio. authenticatedManifest is the closed list of {relativePath, sha256} from those extracted bytes. authenticatedManifest.builtFrom is those extracted regular-file payload bytes from roFd. Directory, symlink, and device members are not sha256 members. Incomplete walk refuses.

preferredApi.retained: top-level descriptorConsumptionRecord only. Forbidden inside objectAuthenticityBindRecord. Forbidden to also emit materializedFileIdentity.

cliInheritedFd.when: only if librpm preferredApi is unavailable (missing librpm). Same archiveSnapshot.
cliInheritedFd.noWritableCopy: Do not copy onto an O_RDWR file. Children consume roFd only. snapFd is closed and MUST NOT be consumed.
cliInheritedFd.handoff: dup2 roFd onto a designated inherited fd N (N>=3). roFd is already O_RDONLY so N is O_RDONLY. fcntl N to clear FD_CLOEXEC. Child argv pathname is exactly /dev/fd/N. Immediately before execve, fstat(roFd) MUST equal archiveSnapshot.identity and F_GET_SEALS MUST still equal F_SEAL_WRITE|F_SEAL_GROW|F_SEAL_SHRINK|F_SEAL_SEAL. MUST NOT pass publisherArchivePath or any other pathname to the child. MUST NOT dup2 the closed O_RDWR snapFd.
cliInheritedFd.checksigSuccess: exit 0 AND stdout contains the exact token "digests signatures OK". Any other exit or missing token refuses.
cliInheritedFd.extractBytes: parent consumes the child stdout cpio stream. Child exit MUST be 0. The stream MUST contain a complete cpio TRAILER!!! member and MUST NOT contain unparsed bytes after that trailer. Any read error, nonzero exit, missing trailer, or trailing member refuses. authenticatedManifest is built from every regular-file member before the trailer. authenticatedManifest.builtFrom is that stream. relativePath via archiveMemberPathGrammar.rpmCpio.
cliInheritedFd.name: rpm-archive-snapshot
cliInheritedFd.retained: top-level materializedFileIdentity only. Forbidden inside objectAuthenticityBindRecord. Forbidden to also emit descriptorConsumptionRecord.

archiveSnapshot.when: before headerBind, on both preferredApi and cliInheritedFd
steps: memfd_create("rpm-archive-snapshot", MFD_CLOEXEC|MFD_ALLOW_SEALING) as snapFd (this descriptor is O_RDWR)
copy every byte from sourceFd to snapFd until EOF; the copied count MUST equal fstat(sourceFd).st_size; any short copy or read error refuses
fstat(roFd) {dev,ino,size} MUST equal fstat(snapFd). F_GET_SEALS(roFd) MUST equal F_SEAL_WRITE|F_SEAL_GROW|F_SEAL_SHRINK|F_SEAL_SEAL. sha-256 of pread(roFd) MUST equal sha-256 of the copied bytes
close(sourceFd) and close(snapFd). publisherArchivePath and the O_RDWR memfd are not used again
all later stages (headerBind, digest, verify, extract) MUST use only roFd
archiveSnapshot.notThis: a held O_RDONLY descriptor on publisherArchivePath. That pins an inode against rename and does not freeze bytes. dup2 of the O_RDWR memfd is not an O_RDONLY descriptor. Seals, not access mode, freeze bytes; the O_RDONLY reopen is required so later stages do not retain a writable-mode fd.
archiveSnapshot.identity: {dev, ino, size, sha256} of roFd after the O_RDONLY reopen. sha256 MUST equal authenticityCore.payload.digest.

headerIdentity.role: optional retained rpm header identity. MUST NOT be used as, derived as, or substituted for authenticityCore.payload.digest. When rpmHeaderIdentity is present it MUST equal this query output for the same NEVRA.
headerIdentity.outputGrammar: exactly 64 lowercase hex characters or refuse
headerIdentity.retainedField: rpmHeaderIdentity on linux-file-backed events when present. Closed {sha256header, nevra, associationToken}. extrasRejected. sha256header MUST equal the normalized 64-hex output of headerIdentity.queryArgv for that same nevra. nevra MUST equal archiveAcquisition.selectionKey. associationToken MUST equal openedObjectObservation.associationToken.

apt-secure.versionedInterface: dpkg-query(1) plus the currently trusted apt Release/Packages index verified by apt-secure (apt-get 1.x/2.x gpgv path). A missing dpkg-query or missing trusted index refuses.
apt-secure.installedSuccess: exit 0, Status contains the exact token "install ok installed", and Version is exactly one non-empty string.
apt-secure.indexSha256: the unique SHA256 field for that name/version in the currently trusted apt Packages index. If the trusted index does not contain exactly one SHA256 for that name/version, refuse.
apt-secure.packageBytes: the unique .deb payload the trusted index associates with that SHA256. authenticityCore.payload.digest MUST equal that 64-hex lowercase SHA256.
apt-secure.nameVersion: authenticityCore.payload.name is the dpkg name; .version is the dpkg Version; digest is the index SHA256.

archiveAcquisition.trustedIndex: the unique currently trusted apt Packages record for this name/version after apt-secure Release verification. Zero or more than one record refuses.
archiveAcquisition.filenameField: the Filename field of that record
archiveAcquisition.acquire: exactly one .deb whose pool path is that Filename
archiveAcquisition.preExtractDigest: sha-256 of those exact .deb bytes MUST equal the Packages SHA256 field AND authenticityCore.payload.digest
archiveAcquisition.extractAfter: only after digest match, extract authenticatedManifest from that .deb data.tar using archiveMemberPathGrammar.debDataTar only.

linuxPackageDb.trustDecision: {scheme: package-db, interfaceId: rpm-checksig|apt-secure, result: success, publisher: knownId}
linuxPackageDb.failClosed: Unmapped publisher, OTHER-PUBLISHER, missing binary, missing publisherArchivePath, snapshot or seal failure, non-unique owning package, failed signature, missing digest, header NEVRA mismatch, incomplete extract, or identifier/trust mismatch refuses before profile qualification.
linuxPackageDb.objectByteJoin: linux-file-backed requires joinMust. linux-pathless requires signed transcriptDigest match, governing recomputeDigest, trustedHandoff, and PE image-digest equality. The subject is firmware-launched-kernel-package. NT_GNU_BUILD_ID is not an executing-kernel bind. Linux remains a D-002 slice-1 platform.

pathlessCeremony.inScopeBootConfigs: UEFI class firmware with TPM 2.0 and TCG2 event log; Secure Boot enabled; firmware boot manager launches BootCurrent whose measured FilePathList is the PE/COFF EFI-stub kernel; a signed measuredBootTranscript matches the log through the first EV_SEPARATOR on each of PCR 0/1/2/4/7; PCR-4 contains transcript-authenticated Calling EFI Application from Boot Option immediately followed in PCR-4 sequence by the kernel EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION; kexecAbsenceDerivation selects the architecture-pinned decompressed payload, finds exactly one IKCONFIG pair in that payload, validates complete Kconfig with explicit disabled requiredN symbols, and the signed object carries kexec-absent plus ikconfigDigest; compression is gzip, xz, zstd, lz4, or none; procfs kexec_load_disabled is absent as corroboration.
pathlessCeremony.refusesBootConfigs: BIOS/legacy; BootCurrent FilePathList is a loader rather than the kernel; no TPM 2.0; no TCG2 log; Secure Boot disabled; non-PE/COFF kernel; SHA-1-only PCR bank; transcript mismatch; missing authenticated action; kernel event not next in PCR-4 sequence; unclassified pre-separator event; failed mandatory recomputeDigest; unsupported compression; architecture-parser failure; zero/duplicate/out-of-payload IKCONFIG pairs; incomplete Kconfig; omitted requiredN symbol; requiredN y/m; signed kexecCapability or ikconfigDigest mismatch; /proc/sys/kernel/kexec_load_disabled present; kexec_loaded=1; malformed EFI_LOAD_OPTION FilePathList parse. Those machines fail qualification. Linux remains in platforms.slice1. No D-096 (A). DRTM is not this profile.

peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.name: PE/COFF Authenticode image digest
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.specification: Windows Authenticode Portable Executable Signature Format, image-hash section. UEFI LoadImage extends this same digest into PCR 4 for EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION.
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.specificationGoverns: Where the enumerated steps are silent or differ from that specification, the specification governs. This is the same supersession form as authenticatedManifest.uniqueness.
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.parse: Parse DOS header, PE signature, FileHeader, and OptionalHeader as PE32 or PE32+. Refuse truncated headers, overlapping structures, integer overflow, OptionalHeader.Magic other than 0x10B or 0x20B, NumberOfSections that overruns the file, SizeOfHeaders that overruns the file or is smaller than the end of the optional header plus section table, and a Security directory whose VirtualAddress/Size overruns the file or wraps.
exclude: IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER.CheckSum (4 bytes at its PE-specified offset)
the attribute certificate table region those 8 bytes name (WIN_CERTIFICATE blob), if present
order: Hash from file offset 0 through the byte immediately before CheckSum
Skip CheckSum (4 bytes; do not hash)
Hash from the byte after CheckSum through the byte immediately before IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY
Skip the 8-byte Security directory entry (do not hash)
Hash from the byte after that entry through SizeOfHeaders exclusive of any byte already skipped
Collect IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER entries. Sort by ascending PointerToRawData. Refuse overlapping raw ranges. Skip sections with SizeOfRawData 0.
For each remaining section in that sorted order, hash exactly SizeOfRawData bytes at PointerToRawData. Accumulate SUM_OF_BYTES_HASHED.
If NumberOfRvaAndSizes > IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY and the Security directory Size is nonzero, the certificate table is excluded.

If file size exceeds SUM_OF_BYTES_HASHED, hash the overlay bytes after SUM_OF_BYTES_HASHED excluding the certificate-table region. Do not hash inter-section gaps that no section raw range covers; the section walk already omitted them.
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.notThis: flat sha-256 of the file bytes, and not a linear hash of the file after skipping only CheckSum and the Security directory.
peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm.testVectors: RESERVED as G22 qualification evidence. Required classes: canonical EFI-stub (walk equals a contiguous layout), inter-section gap, sections not in file order, certificate table present, malformed Security directory refuses, truncated SizeOfRawData refuses. Not populated in this contract.

kernelEventSelection.indices: Each event retains globalLogIndex (full log) and, if pcrIndex is 4, pcr4SequenceIndex (PCR-4 only). These are different integers.
kernelEventSelection.action: the unique PCR-4 EV_EFI_ACTION whose eventPreimage-authenticated action string is exactly Calling EFI Application from Boot Option and that appears before the first PCR-4 EV_SEPARATOR. Zero or more than one refuses.
kernelEventSelection.collect: the unique PCR-4 EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION whose pcr4SequenceIndex equals that action pcr4SequenceIndex plus 1. Non-PCR-4 events may exist between them in global order. Zero or more than one refuses.
kernelEventSelection.bootPath: authenticated Boot#### FilePathList is retained as the configured boot target. It is not compared to UEFI_IMAGE_LOAD_EVENT.DevicePath. The subject kind is firmware-launched-kernel-package.
kernelEventSelection.result: that event is kernelEvent. Any mismatch refuses.

enforcedBootPolicy.measuringAgent: UEFI firmware boot manager. callingFromBootOption MUST be produced by that boot manager before it launches BootCurrent.
enforcedBootPolicy.observableHandoff: The verifier distinguishes LoadImage(K)-then-run(M) from firmware-boot-manager launch of K as follows: the EV_EFI_ACTION text is authenticated by its measured preimage; BootCurrent and Boot#### FilePathList are authenticated by their UEFI_VARIABLE_DATA preimages; the immediately following PCR-4 application digest is authenticated as K peCoffImageDigest; every earlier code-bearing PCR-0/1/2/4 event joins its recomputed digest to a signed TCB member. A db-authorized application that LoadImage(K) and then runs M is either the Boot#### target (then the immediate application digest is that application, not K) or an intervening code-bearing event (then it must be a signed reference and still cannot make K the immediate post-action application). UEFI_IMAGE_LOAD_EVENT.DevicePath is not used. StartImage is not an unobserved MUST.
enforcedBootPolicy.secureBoot: eventLog PCR-7 MUST contain EV_EFI_VARIABLE_DRIVER_CONFIG for SecureBoot with value 1, plus PK, KEK, db, and dbx. Quoted composite pcrDigest MUST include the reconstructed PCR 7.
enforcedBootPolicy.bootVariables: eventLog PCR-1 MUST contain EV_EFI_VARIABLE_BOOT measurements of BootCurrent and the matching Boot#### option. Quoted composite pcrDigest MUST include the reconstructed PCR 1.
enforcedBootPolicy.imageSignature: authenticatedKernelMember PE Authenticode signature MUST verify against the measured db. A dbx match refuses.
enforcedBootPolicy.preKernelAllowlist: every PCR-0/1/2/4 code-bearing event before kernelEvent MUST match a signed TCB member. Unknown pre-kernel code refuses.
enforcedBootPolicy.excludesSyntheticExtend: An OS-time or post-separator PCR-4 extend cannot be kernelEvent. A LoadImage(K) performed by a non-boot-manager application is not immediately after Calling EFI Application from Boot Option for BootCurrent and refuses.
enforcedBootPolicy.runtimeContinuity: OPTIONAL HARDENING. roleGoverns. Not the post-boot interval constraint. Absent indicators MUST NOT refuse this machine. NT-TCB-DISCLOSE-KEXEC is a disclosure, not a pass/fail cell, and buildIdDriftDetector MUST NOT close it. fromBootLockdown is a different field.
enforcedBootPolicy.fromBootLockdown: kexecAbsenceDerivation MUST succeed on the authenticated member bytes. signed kexecCapability MUST equal kexec-absent. Procfs kexec_load_disabled MUST be absent as corroboration. Presence or IKCONFIG y/m refuses. Malformed EFI_LOAD_OPTION (FilePathList parse) refuses.

replayAlgorithm.hashAlg: TPM_ALG_SHA256 only. Other banks are not used and MUST NOT be selected.
replayAlgorithm.init: PCR 1, 2, 4, and 7: 32 zero bytes. PCR 0: if the log contains the defined StartupLocality EV_NO_ACTION (Signature StartupLocality as specified by the pinned PFP), the initial PCR0 value is the PFP locality-dependent startup value for that locality byte and that row MUST NOT be extended. Otherwise PCR 0 initializes to 32 zero bytes.
replayAlgorithm.step: for each TCG_PCR_EVENT2 in eventLog order whose pcrIndex equals the reconstructed PCR AND whose eventType is not EV_NO_ACTION: new = SHA-256(old || event.digests[TPM_ALG_SHA256]). EV_NO_ACTION rows are retained in the log and in the transcript but MUST NOT extend.
replayAlgorithm.composite: pcrDigest MUST equal SHA-256(reconstructedPCR0 || reconstructedPCR1 || reconstructedPCR2 || reconstructedPCR4 || reconstructedPCR7). Individual quoted PCR values are not retained and MUST NOT be compared.
replayAlgorithm.kernelEventInclusion: reconstructed PCR 4 MUST include callingFromBootOption and kernelEvent at their globalLogIndex values.
replayAlgorithm.evNoActionVector: G22 reserves two replay vectors: (1) ordinary EV_NO_ACTION does not change the PCR; (2) StartupLocality EV_NO_ACTION sets PCR0 initial state per the pinned PFP and does not extend.

nonceBind.verifierChallenge: 32-byte CSPRNG value generated by the verifier at quote time. Retained as measuredBootBind.quote.verifierChallenge.
nonceBind.lengthCap: every u16be-framed component except verifierChallenge MUST have byte length <= 65535. A longer runIdentity, observedAt, subject JSON, or signedCarrierDigest refuses. verifierChallenge length is exactly 32.
nonceBind.subjectJson: subject canonical JSON is UTF-8 RFC 8259 with no insignificant whitespace (compact separators), keys exactly kind, name, version, digest in that order, extras rejected, string values escaped only as RFC 8259 section 7 requires (no unnecessary escapes).
nonceBind.preimage: u16be(len(runIdentity utf-8)) || runIdentity utf-8 || u16be(len(observedAt decimal ASCII)) || observedAt decimal ASCII || u16be(len(subject canonical JSON utf-8)) || subject canonical JSON utf-8 || u16be(len(signedCarrierDigest 64-hex utf-8)) || signedCarrierDigest 64-hex utf-8 || u16be(32) || verifierChallenge.
nonceBind.nonce: SHA-256 of that preimage. This is the TPM2_Quote qualifyingData. Unframed concatenation is not this bind.

pathlessCeremony.akJoin: Parse quote.quoted as TPMS_ATTEST: magic TPM_GENERATED_VALUE, type TPM_ST_ATTEST_QUOTE, extraData equal to nonce, attested.quote.pcrSelect equal to quote.pcrSelection, attested.quote.pcrDigest equal to the composite. Derive TPM Name as nameAlg-hash of quote.akTpmtPublic. That Name MUST equal quote.qualifiedSigner. Verify quote.signature as TPMT_SIGNATURE under quote.akTpmtPublic. akCertificateMember MUST be a four-field signedEntry for a certificate-store DIGEST-BOUND allowlist member whose digest binds the AK certificate that certifies that TPMT_PUBLIC. Unknown, unmatched, three-field, or extra certificate refuses.
pathlessCeremony.unavailableRefuses: no TPM 2.0, no TCG2 log, Secure Boot disabled, transcript mismatch, missing authenticated boot-manager action, no unique next PCR-4 kernel event, mandatory recomputeDigest mismatch, unclassified pre-separator event, quote failure, nonce mismatch, composite pcrDigest mismatch, unknown AK, PE/COFF image-digest mismatch, non-PE/COFF kernel member, failed kexecAbsenceDerivation, signed kexecCapability mismatch, present /proc/sys/kernel/kexec_load_disabled, or malformed EFI_LOAD_OPTION refuses this profile on this machine. Linux remains a D-002 slice-1 platform; the machine fails qualification.

eventPreimage.rule: Use recomputeDigest. Do not SHA-256 a value that is already a digest. eventType used to select the grammar MUST be the measuredBootTranscript eventType at that pcrSequenceIndex, not an unauthenticated log label.
eventPreimage.unknownTypeRefuses: A PCR-0/1/2/4/7 event in the governing transcript interval whose type is not in preKernelEventUnion, or that does not match the transcript row, refuses.

preKernelEventUnion.rule: Every PCR-0/1/2/4/7 event in the governing transcript interval MUST match a transcript row and have eventType in codeBearing or configBearing. Every codeBearing row except kernelEvent MUST appear in preKernelReferences with a four-field signedEntry join. That appearance requirement is not waived. recomputeDigest.rule waives only reconstruction from preimageBytes for those rows. Those signedEntry identityEvidence tags MUST be DIGEST-BOUND, and identityEvidence.digest MUST equal the measured code digest (transcript.digestSha256 / event.digests[TPM_ALG_SHA256]), not authenticityCore.payload.digest of a package archive. configBearing rows are exempt from signedEntry only via the transcript-authenticated type. kernelEvent joins authenticatedKernelMember. Unclassified or extra events refuse.

measuredBootTranscript.standing: REQUIRED in the signed TCB inventory for every Linux PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED OS ABI entry. Concrete transcripts are G22 qualification evidence. This contract locks the shape.
measuredBootTranscript.form: closed ordered list of {pcrIndex, pcrSequenceIndex, eventType, digestSha256}. extrasRejected on each row and on the list.
measuredBootTranscript.covers: every PCR-0/1/2/4/7 event from the start of the log through the first EV_SEPARATOR on that same PCR inclusive. PCR-7 SecureBoot/PK/KEK/db/dbx rows used as security facts MUST appear.
measuredBootTranscript.match: eventLog rows on those PCRs in that interval MUST equal the transcript field-for-field in order. The untrusted log eventType is not used to classify or exempt a row until it equals the transcript eventType at that pcrSequenceIndex.
measuredBootTranscript.kernelRow: exactly one transcript row has eventType EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION and digestSha256 equal to authenticatedKernelMember.peCoffImageDigest. That row is kernelEvent. Zero or more than one refuses.
measuredBootTranscript.codeJoin: every codeBearing transcript row except the kernelRow MUST join digestSha256 to a four-field signedEntry per preKernelReferences.join
measuredBootTranscript.configRows: configBearing types are exempt from signedEntry only when the transcript, not the raw log, names that type at that position
measuredBootTranscript.uniqueness: exactly one signed transcript digest per complete platformProfileKey plus OS-ABI signed entry. Using another entry's transcript, or a transcript not bound by measuredBootTranscriptDigest, refuses.
measuredBootTranscript.signedLocation: PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED Linux signedObject.measuredBootTranscriptDigest. Not inside authenticityCore. Not a fifth signedEntry field. Not an inventorySchema TCB member.

recomputeDigest.rule: GOVERNING. Byte recomputation is mandatory only for (a) kernelEvent, from authenticatedKernelMember exact bytes via peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm once, and (b) transcript-authenticated ACTION and VARIABLE rows, from retained action/UEFI_VARIABLE_DATA preimageBytes via SHA-256 once. Those recomputed digests MUST equal event.digests[TPM_ALG_SHA256] and the transcript row digestSha256. For every other code-bearing row, signed digest equality (transcript.digestSha256 == signedEntry DIGEST-BOUND digest == event.digests[TPM_ALG_SHA256]) is the intended proof and byte recomputation is not required. No second SHA-256 is applied to a value that is already a digest. Do not call eventPreimage(event).

PE_IMAGE_TYPES.recomputeDigest: peCoffImageDigestAlgorithm(preimageBytes) once. That output is already SHA-256.

BLOB_TYPES.preimageBytes: exact blob/region bytes named by TCG PFP for that type

ACTION.preimageBytes: the Event bytes as specified by the pinned TCG PFP for EV_EFI_ACTION: an 8-bit (not UCS-2) action string of EventSize bytes, including any specified terminator. Calling EFI Application from Boot Option uses that 8-bit encoding.

VARIABLE.preimageBytes: UEFI_VARIABLE_DATA exactly: UEFI_GUID (16 bytes) || UINT64 UnicodeNameLength (little-endian) || UINT64 VariableDataLength (little-endian) || CHAR16 UnicodeName[UnicodeNameLength] || INT8 VariableData[VariableDataLength]. Not UnicodeName||VariableData alone.
VARIABLE.retained: the full UEFI_VARIABLE_DATA bytes for BootCurrent, Boot####, SecureBoot, PK, KEK, db, and dbx

SEPARATOR.preimageBytes: the separator value defined by TCG PFP

VERSION_AND_HANDOFF.preimageBytes: the type-specific structure defined by TCG PFP
VERSION_AND_HANDOFF.recomputeDigest: SHA-256(preimageBytes) once. Unrecognized EV_EVENT_TAG tag refuses.

recomputeDigest.EV_NO_ACTION: no preimageBytes; no recomputeDigest; no PCR extend

tcgPfp.specification: TCG PC Client Platform Firmware Profile Specification Family 2.0 Level 00 Revision 1.06 v52.
tcgPfp.specificationGoverns: Where enumerated encodings are silent or differ, that pinned edition governs. A later revision is not this contract and requires a successor.

pathlessCeremony.measuredBootTranscriptCanonical: UTF-8 RFC 8259 compact JSON array. Each element is an object with keys exactly pcrIndex, pcrSequenceIndex, eventType, digestSha256 in that order. pcrIndex and pcrSequenceIndex are JSON numbers. eventType is the TCG name string. digestSha256 is 64-hex lowercase. extras rejected. no insignificant whitespace. measuredBootTranscriptDigest is SHA-256 of those bytes.

platformAttestationOperation.unsupportedPairRefuses: macos/package-db, linux/codesign, alpine/arch/OTHER-PUBLISHER PLATFORM-ATTESTED, and any other pair refuse until a later successor adds them.
platformAttestationOperation.fileBackedBinding: macos-codesign: same SecCode guest. linux-file-backed: openedObjectObservation plus matchedManifestMember path+hash. No or-choice.
platformAttestationOperation.failClosed: Unknown interface, failed validity, untrusted chain, unavailable database, ambiguous subject or owning package, or identifier/trust mismatch refuses.

PLATFORM-ATTESTED.observedRecord: loaderTraces.observedPlatformAttestation is the only producer-visible observed PLATFORM-ATTESTED record. authenticityCore stays the signed-to-observed identity member.

DIGEST-BOUND.requires: named collision-resistant digest algorithm identifier plus a canonical collection membership/root rule over the observed bytes.

optionalLibcCompanion.comparison: sonameAbi is metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse and is not authenticity drift. Retained as companionObservation.

identityEvidenceUnion.comparison: The harness compares the observed resolved object to the tagged authenticity evidence. Selector exactness is EXACT-BUILD under identifierSchemes. CLOSED-RANGE is prohibited. Filesystem other-types use OTHER-FSTYPE. SONAME-ABI lives under companions, not tags. sonameAbi never decides identity and never changes allow/refuse.

encodingByTag.PLATFORM-ATTESTED: signed-only envelope sibling sonameAbi: { soname, abiSelector } beside authenticityCore. Never inside payload.
encodingByTag.DIGEST-BOUND: named optional field sonameAbi: { soname, abiSelector } inside the DIGEST-BOUND libc payload.

SONAME-ABI.comparison: metadata only. Presence, absence, or mismatch NEVER changes allow/refuse. Authenticity remains the attested or digest-bound object. When a signed sonameAbi companion is present at the encodingByTag location, the corresponding libc event MUST retain companionObservation. Not identity drift.

pathlessClasses.onlyIf: PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED may be used only for these classes. Other classes MUST NOT use that tag.
pathlessClasses.rule: These classes MUST use volumeConstraint PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED and MUST NOT use INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME or EXTERNAL-ORIGIN. A file-backed install-root volume predicate cannot represent them. A signed OS ABI entry with any other volumeConstraint tag refuses.

pathlessObservation.subject: the closed per-scheme subject variant in PLATFORM-ATTESTED.subjectByScheme; not untyped prose
pathlessObservation.binding: pathlessObservation.scheme/subject plus observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore MUST join per subjectByScheme.binding. Ambiguous, failed, unknown, or mismatched subjects refuse.

pathlessClasses.linuxStanding: OS ABI MUST use PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED. On Linux that tag uses measuredBootBind plus kexecAbsenceDerivation. A member whose IKCONFIG enables kexec fails the machine. Linux is not removed from platforms.slice1.

originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin: Owned only inside volumeConstraint.tags.EXTERNAL-ORIGIN.signedObject for EXTERNAL entries. The pre-existing originSearchPolicy.canonicalOrigin prose is the human meaning; the signed location is the tag object.
originSearchPolicy.allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder: Closed ordered list of lookup steps. Anything outside the list is alternate and refuses.

environmentInfluence.entries: Each named variable maps to exactly one of { standing: FIXED, expectedValue: <canonical string> } or { standing: FORBIDDEN }. Unnamed variables have standing FORBIDDEN.
environmentInfluence.pathAndLoaderDefault: PATH and loader-config substitution variables (LD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH, LD_PRELOAD, DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES, and class-equivalent loader substitution variables) are FORBIDDEN unless the signed entry lists the variable with standing FIXED and a concrete expectedValue. Naming the variable without a fixed value does not make substitution lawful.
environmentInfluence.lookupBinding: Every allowed lookup step in allowedLoaderOrSearchOrder is bound to immutable platformProfile plus signed-entry evidence. A step whose inputs include a FORBIDDEN or unnamed variable refuses.

originSearchPolicy.classAppropriateLookup: Class-specific tool/data lookup rule, or null if the class has none.

volumeConstraint.form: closed tagged union. Required on every signed entry. This is the only signed location of canonicalOrigin and pathlessObservation. Extra fields rejected.

laterEventVariant.observedPlatformAttestation: required when this entry identityEvidence is PLATFORM-ATTESTED; forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND. Closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision}.
laterEventVariant.objectAuthenticityBindRecord: required when PLATFORM-ATTESTED; tag linux-file-backed or macos-codesign. Forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND.

INSTALL-ROOT-VOLUME.join: runPreselectionRecord volume/type equality; Linux also selected-record identity

signedObject.pathlessObservation: required; the closed {scheme, subject} form whose subject is the per-scheme subjectByScheme variant
signedObject.measuredBootTranscriptDigest: required on Linux OS ABI; forbidden on macOS. 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of measuredBootTranscriptCanonical.
signedObject.kexecCapability: required on Linux OS ABI; forbidden on macOS. Exactly the token kexec-absent. MUST equal the derivation output for this entry. Keyed to the same complete platformProfileKey plus OS-ABI signed entry. Cross-entry substitution refuses.
signedObject.linuxForm: exactly {tag, pathlessObservation, measuredBootTranscriptDigest, kexecCapability, ikconfigDigest}. extrasRejected.
signedObject.ikconfigDigest: required on Linux OS ABI; forbidden on macOS. 64-hex lowercase sha-256 of the validated IKCONFIG text C. MUST equal kexecAbsenceDerivation.ikconfigDigest.

laterEventVariant.objectAuthenticityBindRecord: required. macOS: tag macos-codesign. Linux: tag linux-pathless (measuredBootBind). Linux pathless is not withdrawn.
laterEventVariant.measuredBootTranscriptDigest: required on Linux; MUST equal the signed digest. Forbidden on macOS. Retained also as measuredBootBind.transcriptDigest.
laterEventVariant.kexecCapability: required on Linux; MUST equal the signed kexecCapability and kexecAbsenceDerivation output. Forbidden on macOS.

PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED.join: per-scheme subjectByScheme binding from the trusted platform observation to pathlessObservation.subject and observedPlatformAttestation.authenticityCore. observedPlatformAttestation.trustDecision.result MUST be success. Unknown/ambiguous/failed/mismatched refuse. OS ABI entries MUST use this tag. On Linux, later.measuredBootTranscriptDigest MUST equal signed.measuredBootTranscriptDigest and measuredBootBind.transcriptDigest. On Linux, later.kexecCapability MUST equal signed.kexecCapability and the derivation output.

signedObject.canonicalOrigin: required; a full object path after the same symlink-resolving canonicalization as filesystemMeasurementTarget.canonicalization. NFC then UTF-8. Not a search-root identity.

laterEventVariant.observedPlatformAttestation: required when this entry identityEvidence is PLATFORM-ATTESTED; forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND. Closed {authenticityCore, trustDecision}.
laterEventVariant.objectAuthenticityBindRecord: required when PLATFORM-ATTESTED; tag linux-file-backed or macos-codesign. Forbidden when DIGEST-BOUND.

EXTERNAL-ORIGIN.join: resolverObservation.canonicalPath bytes equal observedOrigin.actualOrigin bytes equal signed canonicalOrigin bytes. lookupStepIndex equals event.route. resolvedObjectIdentity is bound by same-event association (runIdentity + observedAt), not by a path projection from object identity. Install-root volume equality is forbidden.

volumeConstraint.defaultForbidden: A signed entry with no volumeConstraint tag is a failed successor. Cross-tag fields rejected.

originSearchPolicy.pathlessObservation: Owned only inside volumeConstraint.tags.PATHLESS-PLATFORM-ATTESTED.signedObject. Not a sibling field.

honestyRepairsFromV2: CODEX-V2-B1: selectorGrammar requires all four members; or-joins forbidden; version/filesystem reserved to population packet; slice1 stems cannot freeze an allowlist.
